# Topology.VirtualLinks.invariant_expression

Exports: `Topology.VirtualLinks.invariant_expression`, `Topology.invariant_expression`

## `invariant_expression(hc::HeegaardCodes.HeegaardCode, algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra) -> KuperbergTensorExpression`

    invariant_expression(hc::HeegaardCodes.HeegaardCode, algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra) -> KuperbergTensorExpression

Return the normalized finite Kuperberg coordinate network of a Heegaard code.

# Arguments
Requires H1–H5 ([conditions](../../specs/hopf-invariants.md#numbered-conditions)).
Numerical involutivity and nonzero distinguished pairing are checked with
`DomainError` identifying the failed algebra requirement. HC validation
errors propagate. Wrong complete-family counts raise `DomainError` naming
alpha or beta; missing words, conflicting owners or invalid passages raise
`ArgumentError`. Full geometric cutting-system and source-port hypotheses
remain caller obligations. Tensor shape and arithmetic errors propagate.

# Returns
A `KuperbergTensorExpression` containing the input `hc`, a new alpha/beta
incidence `link`, coordinate `factors`, scalar `normalization` and algebra
`dimension`, as defined by the
[Kuperberg target](../../specs/hopf-invariants.md#kuperberg-coordinate-target).

# Guarantees
1. On the supported coordinate domain, the expression denotes that normalized finite contraction with the HC entrance's current sign assignment; its intended relation to cellular signs is the [open sign point](../../conventions/Algebra.md#kuperberg-sign-contradiction). [proved/agent: by construction]
2. Inputs are not modified. The returned `hc` field shares the input HC object. [proved/agent: by construction]

# Not guaranteed
The input guards do not certify H1–H3, complete cutting systems, or the
general source invariant identification. The source antipode and
dimension-versus-pairing normalization comparisons remain unverified.
The [intended HC/cellular sign convention](../../conventions/Algebra.md#kuperberg-sign-contradiction)
is undecided; equality with the cellular entrance's contraction is not established.
Numeric tensor formation provides no exact-arithmetic or error certificate.

# Sources
cf:lib/topology.jl/docs/specs/hopf-invariants.md Kuperberg coordinate target and H1–H6 — finite network and geometric boundary.

# Examples
```jldoctest
julia> path = normpath(joinpath(pkgdir(Topology),"..","..","threads","PJ260922","data","261107-lickorish-data","group-15","case-01.hc"));

julia> x = invariant_expression(Topology.HeegaardCodes.read_hc(path),cyclic_group_algebra(2));

julia> isapprox(evaluate_invariant(x),1; atol=1e-8)
true
```

## `invariant_expression(path::AbstractString, algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra) -> KuperbergTensorExpression`

    invariant_expression(path::AbstractString, algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra) -> KuperbergTensorExpression

Read a Heegaard code and return its normalized finite Kuperberg coordinate network.

# Arguments
`path` is a readable file accepted by `HeegaardCodes.read_hc`; I/O, parsing
and HC validation errors propagate. The parsed code and `algebra` require
H1–H5 ([conditions](../../specs/hopf-invariants.md#numbered-conditions)), with
the checks and failures of `invariant_expression(::HeegaardCode,algebra)`.
Complete cutting systems and the geometric/source-port hypotheses remain
caller obligations.

# Returns
A `KuperbergTensorExpression` containing the parsed HC, incidence link,
coordinate factors, normalization and dimension, as defined by the
[Kuperberg target](../../specs/hopf-invariants.md#kuperberg-coordinate-target).

# Guarantees
1. The result is the coordinate expression of the parsed HC and supplied algebra, with the HC method's supported finite meaning and the same [open HC/cellular sign point](../../conventions/Algebra.md#kuperberg-sign-contradiction). [proved/agent: by construction]
2. The input file and algebra are not modified. [proved/agent: by construction]

# Not guaranteed
Parsing and algebra guards do not certify H1–H3 or the full manifold-invariant
identification. The [intended HC/cellular sign convention](../../conventions/Algebra.md#kuperberg-sign-contradiction)
is undecided; equality with the cellular entrance's contraction is not established.
Numeric tensor formation has no exact-arithmetic certificate.

# Sources
cf:lib/topology.jl/docs/specs/hopf-invariants.md Kuperberg coordinate target — finite network and geometric boundary.

# Examples
```jldoctest
julia> path = normpath(joinpath(pkgdir(Topology),"..","..","threads","PJ260922","data","261107-lickorish-data","group-15","case-01.hc"));

julia> isapprox(evaluate_invariant(invariant_expression(path,cyclic_group_algebra(2))),1; atol=1e-8)
true
```

## `invariant_expression(v::VirtualLink, H::URAlgebra) -> URMSTExpression`

    invariant_expression(v::VirtualLink, H::URAlgebra) -> URMSTExpression

Return the exact integer trace matrix associated with one closed real-Gauss component.

# Arguments
Requires U8 ([conditions](../../specs/ur-diagrams.md#numbered-conditions)).
Trailing cut markers, component count, emptiness, signed visits and crossing
signs are checked with `ArgumentError` identifying the unsupported input.
The caller supplies coherent VirtualLink data; other conversion/indexing
errors propagate. Full closed-normality is not certified by these guards.
`H` selects the exact determinant convention.

# Returns
A `URMSTExpression` with the matrix of the
[exact MST convention](../../conventions/URDiagrams.md#exact-mst-word-and-matrix).

# Guarantees
1. Matrix entries are exact integers in the specified real-Gauss coordinate construction. Assigned edge weights do not enter them. [proved/agent: by construction]
2. Inputs are unchanged and the matrix is newly allocated. [proved/agent: by construction]

# Not guaranteed
The matrix can be singular. No equality with the unreduced legacy trace or
general identification with a framed/combed manifold invariant is established;
the specification records the finite evidence and missing source comparison.

# Sources
cf:lib/topology.jl/docs/specs/ur-diagrams.md Exact MST expression — determinant target and geometric evidence boundary.

# Examples
```jldoctest
julia> v = VirtualLink(); set_data!(v; rgauss=[[1,-1]], orientation=[1]);

julia> abs(evaluate_invariant(invariant_expression(v,URAlgebra()))) == 1//BigInt(1)
true
```

## `invariant_expression(v::VirtualLink, H::FiniteHopfAlgebra) -> VirtualLinks.MSTTensorExpression`

    invariant_expression(v::VirtualLink, H::FiniteHopfAlgebra) -> VirtualLinks.MSTTensorExpression

Return the finite structural-tensor network associated with the o-graph data.

# Arguments
Requires H1–H3 ([conditions](../../specs/hopf-invariants.md#numbered-conditions)).
The input and exception boundary is that of `hopf_invariant`'s numeric route:
cut markers and invalid assigned integer weights raise `ArgumentError`.
Coherent Hopf tensors and geometric/framing hypotheses are caller obligations.
Singular inverse antipode powers, indexing and arithmetic errors propagate.

# Returns
A `VirtualLinks.MSTTensorExpression` with `factors` representing the
[structural-tensor contraction](../../specs/hopf-invariants.md#structural-tensor-contraction).

# Guarantees
1. The factors define the supported numeric coordinate network of the supplied diagram and algebra. [proved/agent: by construction]
2. Inputs are not modified. [proved/agent: by construction]

# Not guaranteed
No Hopf-axiom or general manifold-invariance certification is performed.
Floating arithmetic and tolerance-based coefficient omission do not supply
an exact algebraic certificate or a certified error bound.

# Sources
cf:[[MST25#^mst25-blk-0025]] structural-tensor target; full source-port correspondence remains unverified.

# Examples
```jldoctest
julia> v = VirtualLink(); set_data!(v; rgauss=[[1,-1]], orientation=[1]); set_weight!(v,[[-2,1]]);

julia> evaluate_invariant(invariant_expression(v,sweedler_algebra())) ≈ -1
true
```

## `invariant_expression(v::VirtualLink, H::TaftAlgebra) -> AkaghefAlgebra.TaftExpression`

    invariant_expression(v::VirtualLink, H::TaftAlgebra) -> AkaghefAlgebra.TaftExpression

Return the symbolic Taft coordinate contraction associated with the o-graph data.

# Arguments
Requires H2–H4 and H7 ([conditions](../../specs/hopf-invariants.md#numbered-conditions))
for the intended geometric interpretation. Checked: trailing cut markers,
assigned integer-weight mode and finite integral real-edge weights, style
`:L`, valid crossing signs and complete port incidence. Violations raise
`ArgumentError` naming the failure. Full closed-normality and the framing
equation are caller obligations. Conversion/indexing failures propagate.

# Returns
An `AkaghefAlgebra.TaftExpression` with body, closed expression, residual sum
indices, context, trace/timing metadata, ports and weights, in the
[exact Taft route](../../specs/hopf-invariants.md#exact-taft-route).

# Guarantees
1. The expression is the defining symbolic coordinate network for the supplied real-Gauss data and edge weights; no concrete order or root exponent is substituted. [proved/agent: by construction]
2. Inputs are not modified. [proved/agent: by construction]

# Not guaranteed
The expression is not a scalar or a certificate of H2–H3. The general port,
normalization and source-invariant identification remains unverified.

# Sources
cf:[[MST25#^mst25-blk-0025]] the Heisenberg-double contraction target; the repository coordinate comparison has the specification's evidence boundary.

# Examples
```jldoctest
julia> v = VirtualLink(); set_data!(v; rgauss=[[1,-1]], orientation=[1]); set_weight!(v,[[-2,1]]);

julia> x = simplify_invariant(invariant_expression(v,TaftAlgebra(:N)); strategy=:qa);

julia> isempty(x.remaining)
true
```

## `invariant_expression(v::VirtualLink, H::FiniteHopfAlgebra{TaftKind{N,M,S}}) -> Union{AkaghefAlgebra.TaftExpression,VirtualLinks.MSTTensorExpression}`

    invariant_expression(v::VirtualLink, H::FiniteHopfAlgebra{TaftKind{N,M,S}}) -> Union{AkaghefAlgebra.TaftExpression,VirtualLinks.MSTTensorExpression}

Return the supported exact or numeric Taft-tagged coordinate network of an o-graph.

# Arguments
Requires H1–H4 ([conditions](../../specs/hopf-invariants.md#numbered-conditions)).
Input checks and errors are those of the corresponding Taft selector or
generic finite-Hopf `invariant_expression` contract. The raw kind tag alone
does not validate tensor contents; geometric hypotheses are caller obligations.

# Returns
The symbolic expression for the supported unmodified style-L prototype, or
the finite tensor expression otherwise, as defined by the
[exact Taft bridge](../../specs/hopf-invariants.md#exact-taft-route).

# Guarantees
1. The result follows that bridge and reflects the supplied tensor contents. Its symbolic branch leaves order and root exponent for later evaluation. [proved/agent: by construction]
2. Inputs are not modified. [proved/agent: by construction]

# Not guaranteed
A Taft tag does not guarantee use of exact arithmetic. Mutated tensors or
other styles can select the numeric path; neither path certifies H2–H3.

# Sources
cf:lib/topology.jl/docs/specs/hopf-invariants.md Exact Taft route — supported prototype and numeric fallback.

# Examples
```jldoctest
julia> v = VirtualLink(); set_data!(v; rgauss=[[1,-1]], orientation=[1]); set_weight!(v,[[-2,1]]);

julia> x = simplify_invariant(invariant_expression(v,uqsl2_borel_small(1//5)); strategy=:qa);

julia> isempty(x.remaining)
true
```
